rules.title: PSR-12 and strict types
rules.text: Follow PSR-12 and declare strict_types=1 in every file.

rules.title: Form requests
rules.text: Validate input in Form Request classes, not controllers.

rules.title: Eager loading
rules.text: Eager load relations with with() to avoid N+1 queries.

rules.title: Guard mass assignment
rules.text: Define $fillable explicitly and never pass raw request data to create().
